prompt: STATUS has ERR (bit 0) and DONE (bit 1) set, so it reads 0x3. Writing a 1 to a bit clears it; writing 0 does nothing.

explain: `STATUS = 0x1` acknowledges only ERR. But `|=` reads the register first, so it writes back every bit that is currently set, clearing DONE too. For W1C bits, write just the bits you mean to clear.
